newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HORSE RACING-INJURY SIDELINES MELBOURNE CUP HERO SAINTLY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-INJURY SIDELINES MELBOURNE CUP HERO SAINTLY.

text.p: Melbourne Cup winner Saintly has been ruled out of racing for at least a year because of a leg tendon injury, trainer Bart Cummings said on Wednesday.
Cummings, who won his 10th Melbourne Cup with the four-year-old stayer last November, said the gelding may never race again.
"I am not confident that he will come back to work," said Cummings. "All we can do is let nature repair and rescan the tendon in a year."
"It's bad luck but I will carry on as normal and give him plenty of tender loving care," he said.
Owned by Malaysian Dato Tan Chin Nam, Saintly cruised to victory in Melbourne but struggled with a cold and was scratched from the more lucrative Japan Cup later that month.
He had been hot favourite to win the group one Australian Cup in Melbourne on March 10.
